# navis

> Python library for the analysis of neuroanatomical data: skeletons, meshes,
> voxel images and dotprops, with morphometrics, NBLAST, template-brain
> transforms, connectivity analysis and 2D/3D plotting.

Version: 2.0.0-rc.1
Docs: https://navis-org.github.io/navis/  |  Repo: https://github.com/navis-org/navis

This is the condensed API index: every documented object with its parameter
names and one-line summary. Signatures are shown without type annotations.
For complete docstrings fetch the per-section file named under each heading
(e.g. `https://navis-org.github.io/navis/llms-full-neuron-morphology.txt`). `llms-full.txt` holds
all of them concatenated and is large - prefer the per-section files.

## Read this first

What follows is what you cannot infer from signatures and docstrings. The rest
of this file is the API index; the linked per-section files carry the full
docstrings.

### Installation

```bash
pip install navis[all]
```

### Core model

A neuron is one of four types:

| Type | Holds | Made from |
|---|---|---|
| `Skeleton` | skeleton: node table with `node_id`/`parent_id`/`x`/`y`/`z`/`radius` | SWC, `navis.skeletonize()` |
| `Mesh` | vertices + faces | OBJ/STL, `navis.mesh()` |
| `Voxels` | 3D image | NRRD/TIFF, `navis.voxelize()` |
| `Dotprops` | points + local vectors | `navis.make_dotprops()` — **required for NBLAST** |

Explicit conversions go through `navis.skeletonize()`, `navis.mesh()`, `navis.voxelize()`
and `navis.make_dotprops()`. Not every pairing is supported — see the
"Neuron types and functions" compatibility matrix in the API index.

Some functions will implicitly convert a neuron to the required type and then map the result back to the original type. For example, `navis.strahler_index` works on a `Mesh` by converting it to a `Skeleton`, computing the Strahler index, and mapping it back to the `Mesh`.

`NeuronList` is the container. Most functions accept either a single neuron or
a `NeuronList` and return the same shape.

### A few potential pitfalls

#### 1. Optional dependencies

navis has a few optional dependencies that are not installed by default but can greatly
improve performance or enable additional functionality. See installation instructions
in the documentation for details.

#### 2. Brain spaces & units

**This is the most important item on this page.** Neurons from different datasets are likely
in different (template) spaces, and navis itself does not track that. Even within the same
template space you may encounter data in different units - e.g. nanometers, microns or voxels. Fortunately, navis neurons carry an optional `.units` attribute which is often set
by the loader. For example, the demo neurons returned by `navis.example_neurons()` are in **8 nanometer** voxel space, not microns.

The reason this is important is that navis *will not warn you* if you compare, overlay or
NBLAST neurons from different spaces — you may get a plausible, wrong answer.

To align neurons from different template spaces, use `navis.xform_brain()` with a registered transform. For example the `flybrains` package registers the transforms between hemibrain, FlyWire and JRC2018F:

```python
import navis, flybrains          # flybrains registers the transforms

hb = navis.xform_brain(hemibrain_neurons, source='JRCFIB2018Fraw', target='JRC2018F')
fw = navis.xform_brain(flywire_neurons,  source='FLYWIRE',        target='JRC2018F')
# only now are hb and fw comparable
```

For neurons in the same template space but different units, you can either use the `.convert_units()` method (requires the `.units` property to be set) or use simple scaling:

```python
n = navis.example_neurons(2)  # hemibrain skeletons in 8nm voxel space
n_um = n * 8 / 1000           # convert to microns
```

#### 3. NBLAST has three preconditions; only two are checked

`navis.nblast()` requires its inputs to be (a) `Dotprops`, (b) in microns, and
(c) in the same template space.

- **(a) is a hard error** with the fix in the message:
  `TypeError: 'query' must be Dotprop(s), got "(<class '...Skeleton'>,)". Use 'navis.make_dotprops' to convert neurons.`
- **(b) is only a warning:**
  `NBLAST is optimized for data in microns and it looks like your queries may not be in microns.`
  Scores are still returned, and they are not comparable to published ones.
- **(c) is not checked at all.** See item 2.

The full, correct pipeline:

```python
nl = nl.convert_units('um')                    # (b) — do this BEFORE make_dotprops
dp = navis.make_dotprops(nl, k=5, resample=1)  # (a) — k=5 for dense data, k=20 default, resample only needed if neurons are much denses or much sparser than 1 micron
scores = navis.nblast(dp, dp)                  # navis.nblast_allbyall(dp) also works
```

`navis.nblast()` is **asymmetric**: `scores.loc[a, b] != scores.loc[b, a]`. The
default `scores='forward'` returns the raw query→target matrix. Use
`scores='mean'` (or `'min'`/`'max'`) when you want a symmetric matrix — which is
almost always what you want for clustering or a distance matrix.

#### 4. Functions return, they don't mutate (by default)

Every navis function that takes `inplace` defaults to `inplace=False` (28 of
them, no exceptions). So this silently does nothing:

```python
navis.prune_twigs(nl, size=5)      # WRONG — result discarded
nl = navis.prune_twigs(nl, size=5) # right
navis.prune_twigs(nl, size=5, inplace=True) # also right and saves a copy
```

`NeuronList` also auto-dispatches methods and functions over its members, so
`nl.prune_twigs(size=5)` and `nl.convert_units('um')` work and return a new
`NeuronList`.

Chaining several functions with `parallel=True` sends the neurons out to the
workers and back *once per function*. Use `navis.Pipeline` to pay that cost once
for the whole chain — it also lets the later steps skip their defensive copies:

```python
pipe = navis.Pipeline().heal_skeleton().prune_twigs(5000).resample_skeleton(1000)
res = pipe(nl, parallel=True, n_cores=8)
```

#### 5. Names that look alike and aren't

- `navis.mesh()` converts *to* a mesh; `navis.Mesh` is the class;
  `navis.read_mesh()` loads one from disk.
- `navis.smooth_skeleton()` / `smooth_mesh()` / `smooth_voxels()` are three
  different functions — there is no generic `smooth()`.
- `navis.mirror_brain()` takes neurons and is template-aware (needs registered
  transforms); `navis.mirror()` takes a raw `(N, 3)` point array and flips it
  about an axis. They are not interchangeable.
- Inconsistent casing: `navis.neuron2nx()` but `navis.neuron2KDTree()`.
- `navis.betweeness_centrality()` is spelled with one `n` — that is the real
  name, not a typo to correct.

### Verify before you run

`navis.example_neurons()` works offline and needs no credentials. Use it to
check that a snippet runs before pointing it at the user's data:

```python
import navis
nl = navis.example_neurons(2)      # skeletons; kind='mesh' for Meshes
nl.summary()                       # cheap overview: type, cable_length, units, ...
```

`.summary()` on a neuron or `NeuronList` is the right way to inspect results —
prefer it over dumping `.nodes`, which is a full node table and will flood the
context window. For large results, write them out with
`navis.write_parquet()` and read back selectively with `navis.read_parquet()` (see the API reference).

## API index

### Neurons & NeuronLists

Full docstrings: https://navis-org.github.io/navis/llms-full-neurons-neuronlists.txt

- `navis.Skeleton(x, units=None, **metadata)` - Neuron represented as hierarchical tree (i.e. a skeleton).
- `navis.Mesh(x, units=None, process=True, validate=False, **metadata)` - Neuron represented as mesh with vertices and faces.
- `navis.Voxels(x, offset=None, cache=True, units=None, sparsify='auto', **metadata)` - Neuron represented as voxels.
- `navis.Dotprops(points, k, vect=None, alpha=None, units=None, **metadata)` - Neuron represented as points + local vectors.
- `navis.NeuronList(x, make_copy=False, make_using=None, parallel=False, n_cores=None, **kwargs)` - Collection of neurons.

#### General Neuron methods

- `navis.BaseNeuron.copy(deepcopy=False)` - Return a copy of the neuron.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.plot3d(**kwargs)` - Plot neuron using navis.plot3d.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.plot2d(**kwargs)` - Plot neuron using navis.plot2d.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.summary(add_props=None)` - Get a summary of this neuron.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.convert_units(to, inplace=False)` - Convert coordinates to different unit.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.map_units(units, on_error='raise')` - Convert units to match neuron space.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.memory_usage(deep=False, estimate=False)` - Return estimated memory usage of this neuron.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.mask(mask, inplace=False, warn_cut=True)` - Restrict this neuron to part of itself.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.unmask(reset=True, warn_cut=True)` - Undo the innermost mask, in place.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.apply_mask(inplace=False)` - Make the innermost mask permanent.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.attach(name, data, axis=None, *, ids=None, on_rebuild='drop')` - Attach data that selections should carry along.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.attach_link(name, mapping, *, source, target_axis, target='', column=None, cascade='propagate', dangling='drop', on_rebuild='drop')` - Declare that some of this neuron's data names elements of an axis.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.detach(name)` - Drop attached data, and any links or declarations that named it.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.attached()` - What `attach` and `attach_link` have put on this neuron.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.get_mapping(source, target)` - Map every element of one endpoint onto an element of another.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.select_across(source, target, selection)` - Which `source` elements map into a selection of `target` elements.

#### General Neuron properties

- `navis.BaseNeuron.connectors` - Connector table. If none, will return `None`.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.postsynapses` - Table with postsynapses (filtered from connectors table).
- `navis.BaseNeuron.presynapses` - Table with presynapses (filtered from connectors table).
- `navis.BaseNeuron.datatables` - Names of all DataFrames attached to this neuron.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.id` - ID of the neuron.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.name` - Neuron name.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.units` - Units for coordinate space.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.type` - Neuron type.
- `navis.BaseNeuron.soma` - The soma of the neuron (if any).
- `navis.BaseNeuron.bbox` - Bounding box of neuron.

#### Skeletons

- `navis.Skeleton.convert_units(to, inplace=False)` - Convert coordinates to different unit.
- `navis.Skeleton.cell_body_fiber(reroot_soma=True, inplace=False)` - Prune neuron to its cell body fiber.
- `navis.Skeleton.downsample(factor=5, inplace=False, **kwargs)` - Downsample the neuron by given factor.
- `navis.Skeleton.get_graph_nx()` - Calculate and return networkX representation of neuron.
- `navis.Skeleton.get_igraph()` - Calculate and return iGraph representation of neuron.
- `navis.Skeleton.prune_by_longest_neurite(n=1, reroot_soma=False, inplace=False)` - Prune neuron down to the longest neurite.
- `navis.Skeleton.prune_by_strahler(to_prune, inplace=False)` - Prune neuron based on [Strahler order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strahler_number).
- `navis.Skeleton.prune_by_volume(v, mode='IN', prevent_fragments=False, inplace=False)` - Prune neuron by intersection with given volume(s).
- `navis.Skeleton.prune_distal_to(node, inplace=False)` - Cut off nodes distal to given nodes.
- `navis.Skeleton.prune_proximal_to(node, inplace=False)` - Remove nodes proximal to given node. Reroots neuron to cut node.
- `navis.Skeleton.prune_twigs(size, inplace=False, recursive=False)` - Prune terminal twigs under a given size.
- `navis.Skeleton.reload(inplace=False)` - Reload neuron. Must have filepath as `.origin` as attribute.
- `navis.Skeleton.reroot(new_root, inplace=False)` - Reroot neuron to given node ID or node tag.
- `navis.Skeleton.resample(resample_to, inplace=False)` - Resample neuron to given resolution.
- `navis.Skeleton.snap(locs, to='nodes')` - Snap xyz location(s) to closest node or synapse.
- `navis.Skeleton.adjacency_matrix` - Adjacency matrix of the skeleton.
- `navis.Skeleton.cable_length` - Cable length.
- `navis.Skeleton.cycles` - Cycles in neuron (if any).
- `navis.Skeleton.edges` - Edges between nodes.
- `navis.Skeleton.edge_coords` - Coordinates of edges between nodes.
- `navis.Skeleton.igraph` - iGraph representation of this neuron.
- `navis.Skeleton.is_tree` - Whether neuron is a tree.
- `navis.Skeleton.n_branches` - Number of branch points.
- `navis.Skeleton.n_leafs` - Number of leaf nodes.
- `navis.Skeleton.n_skeletons` - Number of seperate skeletons in this neuron.
- `navis.Skeleton.n_trees` - Count number of connected trees in this neuron.
- `navis.Skeleton.nodes` - Node table.
- `navis.Skeleton.root` - Root node(s).
- `navis.Skeleton.sampling_resolution` - Average cable length between child -> parent nodes.
- `navis.Skeleton.segments` - Neuron broken down into linear segments (see also `.small_segments`).
- `navis.Skeleton.simple` - Simplified representation consisting only of root, branch points and leafs.
- `navis.Skeleton.soma_pos` - Search for soma and return its position.
- `navis.Skeleton.subtrees` - List of subtrees. Sorted by size as sets of node IDs.
- `navis.Skeleton.vertices` - Vertices of the skeleton.
- `navis.Skeleton.volume` - Radius-based volume.
- `navis.rewire_skeleton(x, g, root=None, inplace=False)` - Rewire neuron from graph.
- `navis.insert_nodes(x, where, coords=None, validate=True, inplace=False)` - Insert new nodes between existing nodes.
- `navis.remove_nodes(x, which, inplace=False)` - Drop nodes from neuron without disconnecting it.
- `navis.collapse_nodes(x, which, new_co=None, inplace=False)` - Collapse group of nodes into a single node.
- `navis.graph.simplify_graph(G, inplace=False)` - Simplify skeleton graph (networkX or igraph).
- `navis.graph.skeleton_adjacency_matrix(x, sort=True)` - Generate adjacency matrix for a skeleton.

#### Mesh neurons

- `navis.Mesh.faces` - Faces making up the neuron.
- `navis.Mesh.vertices` - Vertices making up the neuron.
- `navis.Mesh.extra_edges` - Edges that are not part of any face.
- `navis.Mesh.trimesh` - Trimesh representation of the neuron.
- `navis.Mesh.volume` - Volume of the neuron.
- `navis.Mesh.sampling_resolution` - Average distance between vertices.
- `navis.Mesh.skeletonize(method='wavefront', heal=True, inv_dist=None, **kwargs)` - Skeletonize mesh.
- `navis.Mesh.snap(locs, to='vertices')` - Snap xyz location(s) to closest vertex or synapse.
- `navis.Mesh.validate(inplace=False)` - Use trimesh to try and fix some common mesh issues.

#### Voxel neurons

- `navis.Voxels.centroid` - Centre of mass of the neuron, in units (i.e. including the offset).
- `navis.Voxels.closing(iterations=1, connectivity=6, fill=None, inplace=False)` - Dilate, then erode: bridges narrow gaps and fills small pits.
- `navis.Voxels.connected_components(connectivity=26)` - Label the neuron's connected components.
- `navis.Voxels.densify(inplace=False)` - Convert to a dense grid representation.
- `navis.Voxels.density` - Fraction of filled voxels.
- `navis.Voxels.dice(other)` - Dice coefficient (F1 score) with `other`.
- `navis.Voxels.difference(other, inplace=False)` - Voxels in this neuron but not in `other` (set subtraction).
- `navis.Voxels.dilate(iterations=1, connectivity=6, fill=None, inplace=False)` - Grow the neuron by its voxel neighbourhood.
- `navis.Voxels.distance_transform(spacing=None, workers=-1)` - Distance from each voxel to the nearest background voxel.
- `navis.Voxels.erode(iterations=1, connectivity=6, inplace=False)` - Shrink the neuron by peeling voxels that touch the background.
- `navis.Voxels.fill_cavities(fill=None, inplace=False, **kwargs)` - Fill enclosed background voids.
- `navis.Voxels.grid` - Voxel grid representation.
- `navis.Voxels.intersection(*others, inplace=False)` - Voxels present in this neuron *and* in every one of the others.
- `navis.Voxels.iou(other)` - Intersection over union (Jaccard index) with `other`.
- `navis.Voxels.max()` - Maximum value (excludes zeros).
- `navis.Voxels.mesh(**kwargs)` - Convert this neuron into a mesh.
- `navis.Voxels.min()` - Minimum value (excludes zeros).
- `navis.Voxels.nnz` - Number of non-zero voxels.
- `navis.Voxels.offset` - Offset in units (not voxels), i.e. the position of voxel (0, 0, 0).
- `navis.Voxels.opening(iterations=1, connectivity=6, fill=None, inplace=False)` - Erode, then dilate: strips specks and thin spurs, keeps bulk shape.
- `navis.Voxels.shape` - Shape of voxel grid.
- `navis.Voxels.skeletonize(**kwargs)` - Convert this neuron into a skeleton.
- `navis.Voxels.sparsify(inplace=False)` - Convert to a sparse voxel representation.
- `navis.Voxels.strip(inplace=False)` - Strip empty voxels (leading/trailing planes of zeros).
- `navis.Voxels.surface_area` - Area of the neuron's exposed (blocky, staircase) surface.
- `navis.Voxels.symmetric_difference(other, fill=None, inplace=False)` - Voxels in exactly one of this neuron and `other` (set XOR).
- `navis.Voxels.thin(inplace=False, **kwargs)` - Thin the neuron to a one-voxel-wide medial curve (centerline).
- `navis.Voxels.threshold(threshold, inplace=False)` - Drop below-threshold voxels.
- `navis.Voxels.union(*others, fill=None, inplace=False)` - Voxels present in this neuron *or* any of the others.
- `navis.Voxels.voxels` - Voxels making up the neuron.

#### Dotprops

- `navis.Dotprops.points` - Center of tangent vectors.
- `navis.Dotprops.vect` - Tangent vectors.
- `navis.Dotprops.alpha` - Alpha values for tangent vectors.
- `navis.Dotprops.to_skeleton(scale_vec='auto')` - Turn Dotprop into a Skeleton.
- `navis.Dotprops.snap(locs, to='points')` - Snap xyz location(s) to closest point or synapse.

#### Converting between types

- `navis.make_dotprops(x, k=20, resample=False, threshold=None, on_issue='warn', make_using=None)` - Produce dotprops from neurons or point clouds.
- `navis.skeletonize(x, **kwargs)` - Turn neuron into skeleton.
- `navis.mesh(x, **kwargs)` - Generate mesh from object(s).
- `navis.voxelize(x, pitch, bounds=None, counts=False, vectors=False, alphas=False, smooth=0)` - Turn neuron into voxels.
- `navis.conversion.voxels2mesh(vox, spacing='auto', step_size=1, smooth=True, chunk_size=None, pad_chunks=None, merge_fragments=None, progress=None)` - Generate mesh from voxels.
- `navis.conversion.voxels2skeleton(vox, method='wavefront', spacing='auto', heal=False, **kwargs)` - Turn voxels into a skeleton.
- `navis.conversion.tree2meshneuron(x, tube_points=8, radius_scale_factor=1, use_normals=True, warn_missing_radii=True)` - Convert Skeleton to Mesh.

#### NeuronList methods

- `navis.NeuronList.apply(func, *, parallel=False, n_cores=None, chunksize=None, backend=None, progress=True, omit_failures=False, **kwargs)` - Apply function across all neurons in this NeuronList.
- `navis.NeuronList.attached()` - Summarise what `attach` and `attach_link` have put on these neurons.
- `navis.NeuronList.head(N=5)` - Return summary for top N neurons.
- `navis.NeuronList.itertuples()` - Helper to mimic `pandas.DataFrame.itertuples()`.
- `navis.NeuronList.mean()` - Return mean numeric and boolean values over all neurons.
- `navis.NeuronList.remove_duplicates(key='name', keep='first', inplace=False)` - Remove duplicate neurons from list.
- `navis.NeuronList.sum()` - Return sum numeric and boolean values over all neurons.
- `navis.NeuronList.summary(N=None, add_props=[], progress=False)` - Get summary over all neurons in this NeuronList.
- `navis.NeuronList.tail(N=5)` - Return summary for bottom N neurons.
- `navis.NeuronList.unmix()` - Split into NeuronLists of the same neuron type.
- `navis.NeuronList.bbox` - Bounding box across all neurons in the list.
- `navis.NeuronList.empty` - Return True if NeuronList is empty.
- `navis.NeuronList.is_degenerated` - Return True if contains neurons with non-unique IDs.
- `navis.NeuronList.is_mixed` - Return True if contains more than one type of neuron.
- `navis.NeuronList.pipeline` - Start a navis.Pipeline bound to this NeuronList.
- `navis.NeuronList.shape` - Shape of NeuronList (N, ).
- `navis.NeuronList.types` - Return neuron types present in this list.

#### Pipelines

- `navis.Pipeline(*steps, elide_copies=True, desc=None)` - A reusable, composable sequence of operations.
- `navis.Pipeline.add(func, *args, **kwargs)` - Add a step and return the new pipeline.
- `navis.Pipeline.add_each(func, *args, **kwargs)` - Add a step that is mapped over the elements of the value.
- `navis.Pipeline.add_once(func, *args, **kwargs)` - Add a step that is called once, with the whole value.

### Visualization

Full docstrings: https://navis-org.github.io/navis/llms-full-visualization.txt

- `navis.plot3d(x, **kwargs)` - Generate interactive 3D plot.
- `navis.plot2d(x, **kwargs)` - Generate 2D plots of neurons and neuropils.
- `navis.plot1d(x, ax=None, color=None, color_by=None, palette=None, **kwargs)` - Plot neuron topology in 1D according to Cuntz et al. (2010).
- `navis.plot_flat(x, layout='subway', connectors=False, highlight_connectors=None, shade_by_length=False, normalize_distance=False, reroot_soma=False, ax=None, **kwargs)` - Plot neuron as flat diagrams.
- `navis.clear3d()` - Clear viewer 3D canvas.
- `navis.close3d()` - Close and forget existing 3D viewer.
- `navis.pop3d()` - Remove the last item added to the 3D canvas.
- `navis.get_viewer()` - Grab active 3D viewer.

#### Plotting Volumes/Meshes

- `navis.Volume(vertices, faces=None, name=None, color=(0.85, 0.85, 0.85, 0.2), id=None, units=None, **kwargs)` - Mesh consisting of vertices and faces.
- `navis.Volume.combine(x, name='comb_vol', color=(0.85, 0.85, 0.85, 0.2))` - Merge multiple volumes into a single object.
- `navis.Volume.plot3d(**kwargs)` - Plot volume using navis.plot3d.
- `navis.Volume.validate()` - Use trimesh to try and fix issues (holes/normals).
- `navis.Volume.resize(x, method='center', inplace=False)` - Resize volume.

### Neuron Morphology

Full docstrings: https://navis-org.github.io/navis/llms-full-neuron-morphology.txt

#### Analyse

- `navis.find_main_branchpoint(x, method='betweenness', threshold=0.95, reroot_soma=False)` - Find main branch point of unipolar (e.g. insect) neurons.
- `navis.find_soma(x, *, dist_factor=3.0)` - Try finding a neuron's soma.
- `navis.find_soma_mesh(x, *, min_soma_radius='1 micron', dist_factor=3.0, min_vertices=20, max_points=200000, n_rays=10, inplace=False)` - Detect the soma of a Mesh from its geometry.
- `navis.form_factor(x, start=-3, stop=3, num=601, parallel=False, n_cores=None, progress=True)` - Calculate form factor for given neuron.
- `navis.persistence_points(x, descriptor='root_dist', remove_cbf=False)` - Calculate points for a persistence diagram.
- `navis.persistence_vectors(x, threshold=None, samples=100, bw=0.2, center=False, **kwargs)` - Produce vectors from persistence points.
- `navis.strahler_index(x, method='standard', to_ignore=[], min_twig_size=None)` - Calculate Strahler Index (SI).
- `navis.segment_analysis(x)` - Calculate morphometric properties a neuron's segments.
- `navis.ivscc_features(x, features=None, missing_compartments='ignore', verbose=False, progress=True)` - Calculate IVSCC features for neuron(s).
- `navis.sholl_analysis(x, radii=10, center='centermass', geodesic=False)` - Run Sholl analysis for given neuron(s).
- `navis.tortuosity(x, seg_length=None)` - Calculate tortuosity of a neuron.
- `navis.betweenness_centrality(x, from_=None, directed=True)` - Calculate vertex/node betweenness.
- `navis.branch_angles(x, degrees=True)` - Compute branch (bifurcation) angles.
- `navis.path_angles(x, degrees=True)` - Compute path angles.
- `navis.root_angles(x, degrees=True)` - Compute root angles.
- `navis.soma_exit_angles(x, degrees=True)` - Compute soma-exit angles.
- `navis.propagate_labels(x, labels, clamping=True, weights=None, directed=False, max_iter=10000, tol=1, return_probs=False, verbose=False)` - Propagate labels from a subset of nodes/vertices to the rest of the neuron.

#### Manipulate

- `navis.average_skeletons(x, limit=10, base_neuron=None)` - Compute an average from a list of skeletons.
- `navis.break_fragments(x, labels_only=False, min_size=None)` - Break neuron into its connected components.
- `navis.despike_skeleton(x, sigma=5, max_spike_length=1, inplace=False, reverse=False)` - Remove spikes in skeleton (e.g. from jumps in image data).
- `navis.drop_fluff(x, keep_size=None, n_largest=None, epsilon=None, connectivity=26, inplace=False)` - Remove small disconnected pieces of "fluff".
- `navis.fill_holes(x, inplace=False)` - Triangulate the holes in a mesh.
- `navis.cell_body_fiber(x, method='betweenness', reroot_soma=True, heal=True, threshold=0.95, inverse=False, inplace=False)` - Prune neuron to its cell body fiber.
- `navis.combine_neurons(*x)` - Combine multiple neurons into one.
- `navis.cut_skeleton(x, where, ret='both')` - Split skeleton at given point and returns two new neurons.
- `navis.guess_radius(x, method='linear', limit=None, smooth=True, inplace=False)` - Guess radii for skeleton nodes.
- `navis.heal_skeleton(x, method='ALL', max_dist=None, min_size=None, use_radius=False, drop_disc=False, mask=None, inplace=False)` - Heal fragmented skeleton(s).
- `navis.heal_mesh(x, max_dist=None, min_size=None, drop_disc=False, mask=None, inplace=False)` - Heal fragmented mesh(es).
- `navis.longest_neurite(x, n=1, reroot_soma=False, from_root=True, inverse=False, inplace=False)` - Return a neuron consisting of only the longest neurite(s).
- `navis.prune_by_strahler(x, to_prune, inplace=False, reroot_soma=True, force_strahler_update=False)` - Prune neuron based on [Strahler order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strahler_number).
- `navis.prune_twigs(x, size, exact=False, mask=None, inplace=False, recursive=False)` - Prune terminal twigs under a given size.
- `navis.prune_at_depth(x, depth, *, source=None, inplace=False)` - Prune all neurites past a given distance from a source.
- `navis.reroot_skeleton(x, new_root, inplace=False)` - Reroot neuron to new root.
- `navis.split_axon_dendrite(x, metric='synapse_flow_centrality', flow_thresh=0.9, split='prepost', cellbodyfiber=False, reroot_soma=True, label_only=False)` - Split a neuron into axon and dendrite using flow metrics.
- `navis.split_axon_dendrite_prop(x, use_weights='balance', alpha=1, max_iter=10000, tol=1, label_only=False, verbose=False)` - Split a neuron into axon and dendrite using label propagation.
- `navis.split_into_fragments(x, n=2, min_size=None, reroot_soma=False)` - Split neuron into fragments.
- `navis.stitch_skeletons(*x, method='ALL', master='SOMA', max_dist=None, min_size=None, use_radius=False)` - Stitch multiple skeletons together.
- `navis.subset_neuron(x, subset, inplace=False, keep_disc_cn=False, prevent_fragments=False, cap_holes=False, track=False)` - Subset a neuron to a given set of nodes/vertices.
- `navis.merge_subset(x, subset, inplace=False)` - Fold a tracked subset back into the neuron it was taken from.
- `navis.masked(x, mask, reset=True, warn_cut=True)` - Work on part of a neuron, then put it back.
- `navis.smooth_skeleton(x, window=5, to_smooth=['x', 'y', 'z'], inplace=False)` - Smooth skeleton(s) using rolling windows.
- `navis.smooth_mesh(x, iterations=5, L=None, method='taubin', backend=None, inplace=False, **kwargs)` - Smooth meshes (TriMesh, Mesh, Volume).
- `navis.smooth_voxels(x, sigma=1, backend='sparsecubes', epsilon=0, truncate=4.0, inplace=False)` - Smooth voxel(s) using a Gaussian filter.
- `navis.thin_voxels(x, backend='auto', inplace=False, **kwargs)` - Skeletonize image data to single voxel width.

#### Resampling

- `navis.resample_skeleton(x, resample_to, inplace=False, method='linear', map_columns=None, skip_errors=True, preserve_volume=False)` - Resample skeleton(s) to given resolution.
- `navis.sample_skeleton(x, *, n_points=None, density=None, spacing=None)` - Sample points at equal spacing along a skeleton.
- `navis.resample_along_axis(x, interval, axis=2, old_nodes='remove', inplace=False)` - Resample neuron such that nodes lie exactly on given 1d grid.
- `navis.downsample_neuron(x, downsampling_factor, inplace=False, preserve_nodes=None, method='simple')` - Downsample neuron(s) by a given factor.
- `navis.simplify_mesh(x, F, backend=None, inplace=False, **kwargs)` - Simplify meshes (TriMesh, Mesh, Volume).

#### Comparing morphology

- `navis.nblast(query, target=None, scores='forward', normalized=True, use_alpha=False, smat='auto', limit_dist=None, approx_nn=False, precision=64, n_cores=None, progress=True, backend=None, smat_kwargs={})` - NBLAST query against target neurons.
- `navis.nblast_smart(query, target=None, t=90, criterion='percentile', scores='forward', return_mask=False, normalized=True, use_alpha=False, smat='auto', limit_dist='auto', approx_nn=False, precision=64, n_cores=None, progress=True, backend=None, smat_kwargs={})` - Smart(er) NBLAST query against target neurons.
- `navis.nblast_allbyall(x, normalized=True, use_alpha=False, smat='auto', limit_dist=None, approx_nn=False, precision=64, n_cores=None, progress=True, backend=None, smat_kwargs={})` - All-by-all NBLAST of inputs neurons.
- `navis.nblast_knn(query, target=None, k=20, scores='mean', n_candidates=200, format='long', normalized=True, use_alpha=False, smat='auto', limit_dist=None, precision=64, n_cores=None, progress=True, backend=None, voxel=20.0, n_dirs=3, splat=True, smat_kwargs={})` - Find the `k` nearest neighbours of each neuron, without the full matrix.
- `navis.nblast_align(query, target=None, align_method='rigid', two_way_align=True, sample_align=None, scores='mean', normalized=True, use_alpha=False, smat='auto', limit_dist=None, approx_nn=False, precision=64, n_cores=None, progress=True, dotprop_kwargs={}, align_kwargs={}, smat_kwargs={})` - Run NBLAST on pairwise-aligned neurons.
- `navis.synblast(query, target, by_type=False, cn_types=None, scores='forward', normalized=True, smat='auto', n_cores=None, progress=True, backend=None)` - Synapsed-based variant of NBLAST.
- `navis.persistence_distances(q, t=None, augment=True, normalize=True, bw=0.2, **persistence_kwargs)` - Calculate morphological similarity using persistence diagrams.
- `navis.nbl.smat.Lookup2d(axis0, axis1, cells)` - Convenience class inheriting from LookupNd for the common 2D float case.
- `navis.nbl.smat.Digitizer(boundaries, clip=(True, True), right=False)` - Class converting continuous values into discrete indices.
- `navis.nbl.smat.LookupDistDotBuilder(dotprops, matching_lists, nonmatching_list=None, use_alpha=False, draw_strat='batched', seed=1991)` - Class for building a 2-dimensional score lookup for NBLAST.
- `navis.nbl.make_clusters(x, t, criterion='n_clusters', method='ward', **kwargs)` - Form flat clusters.
- `navis.nbl.update_scores(queries, targets, scores_ex, nblast_func, **kwargs)` - Update score matrix by running only new query->target pairs.
- `navis.nbl.compress_scores(scores, threshold=None, digits=None)` - Compress scores.
- `navis.nbl.extract_matches(scores, N=None, threshold=None, percentage=None, axis=0, distances='auto', max_matches=None)` - Extract top matches from score matrix.
- `navis.nbl.nblast_prime(scores, n_dim=0.2, metric='euclidean')` - Generate a smoothed version of the NBLAST scores.

#### Polarity metrics

- `navis.bending_flow(x)` - Calculate synapse "bending" flow.
- `navis.flow_centrality(x)` - Calculate flow between leaf nodes.
- `navis.synapse_flow_centrality(x, mode='sum')` - Calculate synapse flow centrality (SFC).
- `navis.arbor_segregation_index(x)` - Per arbor seggregation index (SI).
- `navis.segregation_index(x)` - Calculate segregation index (SI).

#### Distances

- `navis.cable_overlap(a, b, dist=2, method='min')` - Calculate the amount of cable of neuron A within distance of neuron B.
- `navis.distal_to(x, a=None, b=None)` - Check if nodes A are distal to nodes B.
- `navis.dist_between(x, a, b)` - Get the geodesic distance between nodes in nanometers.
- `navis.dist_to_root(x, weight=None, igraph_indices=False)` - Calculate distance to root for each node.
- `navis.geodesic_matrix(x, from_=None, to_=None, directed=False, weight='weight', limit=inf)` - Generate geodesic ("along-the-arbor") distance matrix between nodes/vertices.
- `navis.graph.geodesic_clusters(x, max_dist, weight='weight', seeds=None, connected=True)` - Partition a neuron into clusters of bounded geodesic radius.
- `navis.segment_length(x, segment)` - Get length of a linear segment.

### Machine Learning

Full docstrings: https://navis-org.github.io/navis/llms-full-machine-learning.txt

- `navis.ml.normalize_neuron(x, center='centroid', scale='rms', rotate='pca', return_matrix=False)` - Normalize a neuron's pose: center, orient and scale it canonically.
- `navis.ml.augment_neuron(x, drop=None, warp=None, rotate=None, scale=None, translate=None, jitter=None, random_state=None)` - Apply a pipeline of augmentations in one call.
- `navis.ml.jitter_neuron(x, sigma, random_state=None)` - Perturb coordinates with Gaussian noise.
- `navis.ml.rotate_neuron(x, axis=None, max_angle=None, random_state=None)` - Rotate a neuron by a random rotation about its centroid.
- `navis.ml.translate_neuron(x, magnitude, random_state=None)` - Shift a neuron by a random translation.
- `navis.ml.scale_neuron(x, scale_range=(0.8, 1.25), anisotropic=False, random_state=None)` - Scale a neuron by a random factor about its centroid.
- `navis.ml.warp_neuron(x, sigma=0.5, magnitude=0.05, grid=3, random_state=None)` - Apply a smooth elastic deformation.
- `navis.ml.drop_nodes(x, fraction=0.1, random_state=None)` - Randomly drop a fraction of a neuron's nodes/points.
- `navis.ml.chunk_neuron(x, size, mode='partition', connected=True, k=None, sampling_factor=1, weight='weight', undersized='pad', pad_value=-1, random_state=None)` - Break a neuron into evenly sized fragments.
- `navis.ml.sample_patches(x, *, n_points, density=None, spacing=None, mode='spaced', connected=True, foveate=None, reach=32, fovea=0, k=None, sampling_factor=1, undersized='keep', pad_value=-1, interpolate=None, weights=None, surface_mode='even', attributes=None, random_state=None)` - Resample a neuron at a target density, then tile it into fixed-size patches.
- `navis.ml.sample_cable(x, *, n_points=None, density=None, spacing=None, interpolate=None, weights=None, random_state=None)` - Sample points at uniform arclength along a skeleton, carrying attributes.
- `navis.ml.sample_surface(x, *, n_points=None, density=None, spacing=None, mode='even', attributes=None, random_state=None)` - Sample points on a mesh surface, keeping each point's source vertex.
- `navis.ml.sample_points_uniform(points, size, output='points', method='auto')` - Draw a uniform sample from a point cloud.
- `navis.ml.estimate_spacing(points, aggregate='median')` - Estimate the characteristic point spacing of a cloud.

- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.add_voltage_record(where, label=None)` - Add voltage recording to model.

- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.connect(pre, where, syn_tau1=0.1, syn_tau2=10, syn_rev_pot=0, cn_thresh=10, cn_delay=1, cn_weight=0)` - Connect object to model.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.get_node_section(node_ids)` - Return section(s) for given node(s).
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.get_node_segment(node_ids)` - Return segment(s) for given node(s).
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.inject_current_pulse(where, start=5, duration=1, current=0.1)` - Add current injection (IClamp) stimulation to model.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.plot_results(axes=None)` - Plot results.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.insert(mechanism, subset=None, **kwargs)` - Insert biophysical mechanism for model.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.uninsert(mechanism, subset=None)` - Remove biophysical mechanism from model.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.Ra` - Axial resistance [Ohm * cm] of all sections.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.cm` - Membran capacity [micro Farads / cm^2] of all sections.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.label` - Name/label of the neuron.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.n_records` - Number of records (across all types) active on this model.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.n_sections` - Number of sections in this model.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.n_stimuli` - Number of stimuli active on this model.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.nodes` - Node table of the skeleton.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.records` - Return mapping of node ID(s) to recordings.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.sections` - List of sections making up this model.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.stimuli` - Return mapping of node ID(s) to stimuli.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.synapses` - Return mapping of node ID(s) to synapses.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.comp.CompartmentModel.t` - The global time. Should be the same for all neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork()` - A Network of Leaky-Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) point processes.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.add_background_noise(ids, frequency, randomness=0.5, independent=True)` - Add background noise to given neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.add_neurons(ids, model='IntFire1', labels=None, skip_existing=False, **props)` - Add neurons to network.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.add_stimulus(ids, start, frequency, stop=None, duration=None, randomness=0.5, independent=True, label=None, weight=1)` - Add stimulus to given neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.connect(source, target, weight, delay=5)` - Connect two neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.from_edge_list(edges, model='IntFire1', source_col='source', target_col='target', weight_col='weight', **props)` - Generate network from edge list.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.get_spike_counts(bin_size=50, subset=None, rolling_window=None, group=False)` - Get matrix of spike counts.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.plot_raster(subset=None, group=False, stimuli=True, ax=None, label=False, backend='auto', **kwargs)` - Raster plot of spike timings.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.plot_traces(bin_size=100, subset=None, rolling_window=None, group=False, stimuli=True, ax=None, backend='auto', **kwargs)` - Plot mean firing rate.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.run_simulation(duration=25, v_init=-65)` - Run the simulation.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.set_labels(labels)` - Set labels for neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.edges` - Edges between nodes of the network.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.ids` - IDs of neurons in the network.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.labels` - Labels of neurons in the network.
- `navis.interfaces.neuron.network.PointNetwork.neurons` - Neurons in the network.

#### NeuroMorpho API

- `navis.interfaces.neuromorpho.get_neuron_info(x)` - Fetch neuron info by ID or by name.
- `navis.interfaces.neuromorpho.get_neuron(x, parallel=True, max_threads=4, errors=None, **kwargs)` - Fetch neuron by ID or by name.
- `navis.interfaces.neuromorpho.get_neuron_fields()` - List all available neuron fields.
- `navis.interfaces.neuromorpho.get_available_field_values(field)` - List all possible values for given neuron field.

#### neuPrint API

- `navis.interfaces.neuprint.fetch_roi(roi, *, client=None)` - Fetch given ROI.
- `navis.interfaces.neuprint.fetch_skeletons(x, *, with_synapses=False, dedup=True, heal=False, missing_swc='raise', parallel=True, max_threads=5, errors=None, client=None)` - Fetch neuron skeletons as navis.Skeletons.
- `navis.interfaces.neuprint.fetch_mesh_neuron(x, *, lod=1, with_synapses=False, dedup=True, missing_mesh='raise', parallel=True, max_threads=5, errors=None, seg_source=None, client=None, **kwargs)` - Fetch neuron meshes as navis.Mesh.
- `navis.interfaces.neuprint.fetch_synapses(neuron_criteria, synapse_criteria=None, batch_size=10, *, dedup=True, nt=None, client=None)` - Fetch synapses for a neuron or selection of neurons.

#### InsectBrain DB API

- `navis.interfaces.insectbrain_db.authenticate(username=None, password=None, token=None)` - Authenticate against Insect Brain DB.
- `navis.interfaces.insectbrain_db.get_brain_meshes(species, combine=False, max_threads=4, errors=None)` - Fetch brain meshes for given species.
- `navis.interfaces.insectbrain_db.get_species_info(species)` - Get all info for given species.
- `navis.interfaces.insectbrain_db.get_available_species()` - Get all info for given species.
- `navis.interfaces.insectbrain_db.get_skeletons(x, max_threads=4, errors=None)` - Fetch skeletons for given neuron(s).
- `navis.interfaces.insectbrain_db.get_skeletons_species(species, max_threads=4, errors=None)` - Fetch all skeletons for given species.
- `navis.interfaces.insectbrain_db.search_neurons(name=None, short_name=None, species=None, sex=None, arborization=None, partial_match=True)` - Search for neurons matching given parameters.

#### Brain Image Library API

- `navis.interfaces.brain_image_library.search(*, limit=None, metadata=True, parallel=True, max_threads=4, **filters)` - Search BIL for datasets matching the given criteria.
- `navis.interfaces.brain_image_library.query(division, element, value)` - Run a single raw query against the BIL metadata API.
- `navis.interfaces.brain_image_library.get_metadata(x, *, raw=False, parallel=True, max_threads=4, chunk_size=100)` - Fetch metadata for one or more BIL datasets.
- `navis.interfaces.brain_image_library.get_dataset_url(x)` - Return the download URL(s) for the given dataset(s).
- `navis.interfaces.brain_image_library.list_files(x, pattern=None, *, recursive=True, max_depth=3, max_files=10000, max_requests=500, force=False, parallel=True, max_threads=4)` - List the files in a BIL dataset.
- `navis.interfaces.brain_image_library.download_files(x, filepath, pattern=None, *, max_size='10G', skip_existing=True, parallel=True, max_threads=4, **kwargs)` - Download files from a BIL dataset.
- `navis.interfaces.brain_image_library.get_neurons(x, pattern='*.swc', *, max_neurons=None, parallel=True, max_threads=4, **kwargs)` - Fetch neuron reconstructions from a BIL dataset.
- `navis.interfaces.brain_image_library.clear_metadata_cache()` - Clear the in-process metadata cache.

#### Blender API

- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler(scaling=0.0001, axes_order=[0, 1, 2], ax_translate=[1, 1, 1])` - Class that interfaces with scene in Blender.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.add(x, neurites=True, soma=True, connectors=True, redraw=False, use_radii=False, skip_existing=False, downsample=False, collection=None, **kwargs)` - Add neuron(s) to scene.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.clear()` - Clear all neurons
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.select(x, *args)` - Select given neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.hide()` - Hide all neuron-related objects.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.unhide()` - Unide all neuron-related objects.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.color(r, g, b)` - Assign color to all neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.colorize()` - Randomly colorize ALL neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.emit(v)` - Change emit value.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.use_transparency(v)` - Change transparency (True/False).
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.alpha(v)` - Change alpha (0-1).
- `navis.interfaces.blender.Handler.bevel(r)` - Change bevel of ALL neurons.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.select(unselect_others=True)` - Select objects in 3D viewer
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.color(r, g, b, a=1)` - Assign color to all objects in the list.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.colorize(groups=None, palette='hls')` - Assign colors across the color spectrum.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.emit(e)` - Change emit value.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.use_transparency(t)` - Change transparency (True/False).
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.alpha(a)` - Change alpha (0-1).
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.bevel(r)` - Change bevel radius of objects.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.hide(viewport=True, render=False)` - Hide objects.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.unhide(viewport=True, render=False)` - Unhide objects.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.hide_others()` - Hide everything BUT these objects.
- `navis.interfaces.blender.ObjectList.delete()` - Delete neurons in the selection.

#### Allen MICrONS datasets

- `navis.interfaces.microns.get_cave_client(datastack='cortex65')` - Get caveclient for given datastack.
- `navis.interfaces.microns.fetch_neurons(x, *, lod=2, with_synapses=True, datastack='cortex65', materialization='auto', parallel=True, max_threads=4, errors=None, **kwargs)` - Fetch neuron meshes.

#### H01 dataset

- `navis.interfaces.h01.get_cave_client(datastack='h01_c3_flat')` - Get caveclient for H01 dataset.
- `navis.interfaces.h01.fetch_neurons(x, *, lod=2, with_synapses=True, datastack='h01_c3_flat', materialization='auto', parallel=True, max_threads=4, errors=None, **kwargs)` - Fetch neuron meshes.

### Neuron types and functions

As you can imagine not all functions will work on all neuron types. For example
it is currently not possible to find the longest neurite via
navis.longest_neurite for a navis.Voxels.
Conversely, some functionality like "smoothing" makes sense for multiple neuron types but the
application is so vastly different between e.g. meshes and skeletons that
there are specicialized functions for every neuron type.

Below table has an overview for which functions work with which neuron types:

|                            | Skeleton | Mesh | Voxels | Dotprops |
|----------------------------|------------|------------|-------------|----------|
| navis.plot2d             | yes        | yes        | limited     | yes      |
| navis.plot3d             | yes        | yes        | see backend | yes      |
| navis.plot1d             | yes        | no         | no          | no       |
| navis.plot_flat          | yes        | no         | no          | no       |
| navis.subset_neuron      | yes        | yes        | yes         | yes      |
| navis.in_volume          | yes        | yes        | yes         | yes      |
| smoothing                  | navis.smooth_skeleton | navis.smooth_mesh | navis.smooth_voxels | no |
| navis.downsample_neuron  | yes        | yes        | yes         | yes      |
| navis.cast_neuron             | yes        | yes        | yes         | yes      |
| resampling (e.g. navis.resample_skeleton) | yes | no |       no | no        |
| navis.make_dotprops      | yes        | yes        | yes         | yes      |
| NBLAST (navis.nblast, etc.) | no[^1]       | no[^1]         | no[^1]          | yes      |
| navis.xform_brain        | yes        | yes        | yes (slow!) | yes      |
| navis.mirror_brain       | yes        | yes        | no          | yes      |
| navis.skeletonize        | no         | yes        | yes         | yes      |
| navis.mesh               | yes        | no         | yes         | no       |
| navis.voxelize           | yes        | yes        | no          | yes      |
| navis.drop_fluff         | yes        | yes        | yes         | yes      |
| navis.break_fragments    | yes        | yes        | no          | no       |

[^1]: Use navis.make_dotprops to turn these neurons into navis.Dotprops.

### Not covered above

Public objects that are not yet in the curated index. They exist and work;
call `help(navis.<name>)` for details.

`navis.BaseNeuron`, `navis.Neuron`, `navis.PipelineStepError`, `navis.SomaEllipsoid`, `navis.fix_mesh`, `navis.geodesic_clusters`, `navis.inspect_h5`, `navis.read_h5`, `navis.render_template`, `navis.vary_colors`, `navis.write_h5`
